gloss: to pour into; to wash down

definitions.gloss: to pour into; to wash down
definitions.explanation: To pour a liquid or fluid substance into a container, mold, or opening; also to swallow food or medicine by washing it down with a drink.

examples.japanese: ⟦コンクリート→コンクリート：10858_konkuriito⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{型|かた}→型：02146_kata⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{流|なが}し{込|こ}む。
examples.english: To pour concrete into the mold.

examples.japanese: ⟦{錠剤|じょうざい}→錠剤：17290_jouzai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{水|みず}→水：02258_mizu⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{流|なが}し{込|こ}んだ。
examples.english: I washed down the tablet with water.

examples.japanese: ⟦{溶|と}かした→溶かす：08264_tokasu⟧⟦{金属|きんぞく}→金属：02645_kinzoku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{型|かた}→型：02146_kata⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{流|なが}し{込|こ}んで⟦{部品|ぶひん}→部品：00020_buhin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{作|つく}る→作る：00481_tsukuru⟧。
examples.english: Molten metal is poured into a mold to make the parts.

notes:
TRANSITIVITY: Transitive godan verb. X⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧(Y⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧){流|なが}し{込|こ}む. A compound of ⟦{流|なが}す→流す：01968_nagasu⟧ (to pour, to let flow) and ⟦{込|こ}む→込む：00719_komu⟧ (to put in), stressing that the liquid is directed into a specific place.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{型|かた}→型：02146_kata⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{流|なが}し{込|こ}む: to pour into a mold
- ⟦{一気|いっき}→一気：08891_ikki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{流|なが}し{込|こ}む: to gulp down in one go
- ⟦{薬|くすり}→薬：00793_kusuri⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{水|みず}→水：02258_mizu⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{流|なが}し{込|こ}む: to wash down medicine with water
